hypothesis: Compact scalar-remainder consumers after a second LV invocation may exit through one dedicated LCSSA forwarding block before the existing result join. Checking that edge structurally, and tracing exact typed scalar/vector results to stores, admits the retained sound LV2 form without relying on label suffixes or weakening count provenance. This is an execution-validator repair, not a compiler legality or profitability change.
semantics: The scalar-remainder branch retains all existing participating P/export/guard, rounded-bound, bypass, branch-polarity and tail-termination checks, then invokes a bounded fixture certificate. It derives predecessors from actual label operands in instructions (including unexpected switch/invoke edges), discarding printed predecessor comments. The true tail edge remains the self backedge; the false edge goes directly to the existing join or to exactly one block with that tail as its sole predecessor, typed single-input PHIs forwarding the actual reduction updates, and an unconditional edge to the join. The join has exactly the vector-middle and direct/forwarded tail predecessors and exact typed result operands. Every tail recurrence and scalar resume start/backedge is checked. Integer vector results must come from corresponding typed vector-add reductions; ordered double/float results must come from flag-free ordered reduction calls. Direct vector updates or the observed one typed middle.block LCSSA PHI are linked to the resume and result join; vector recurrence starts/backedges are retained. Arbitrary copy expressions, extra computations/effects, wrong types/values, extra predecessors, conditional forwarding, cycles and longer chains fail. The result join and empty-path starts then link through the demonstrated optional output LCSSA block and final PHIs to exact stores, integer result combination or enclosing compact row stores/carry. All matching is fixture-scoped; it is not a general LLVM IR equivalence proof. Existing EVL, completed-count, enclosing-exit, metadata/refinement and signature-specialization certificates are unchanged. Fresh actual-opt original/transformed/independent execution comparisons remain mandatory under separate strict and explicitly reordered policies.
costs: No target transformation changes: scratch capacity, traffic, input rereads, contribution recomputation, producer duplication, guards, analysis passes and profitability remain unchanged. The new certificate uses fixed-depth typed patterns, exact PHI operand lists and predecessor scans over fixed-size fixtures; it never walks arbitrary chains, solves equivalences or allocates target storage. The C harness adds per-variant coverage bits to the existing full P sweep, with no added target instructions or comparison iterations. Existing scratch is entry-allocated M times unique contribution sizes plus padding, capped at 65536 bytes per candidate and the signed pointer-index bound. M=65 mixed streams account for 1044 bytes (65*i32 + 65*double + 65*float + 4 padding), with 16*P logical store bytes and 16*P load bytes for compact streams (16*N each for full streams). Enclosing rows reuse 784 accounted bytes with 12*N stores and 12*N loads per row; capacity does not grow with row count. Scalar i32 capacity fixtures reserve 4/1020/65536 bytes at M=1/255/16384, transferring 8*N bytes total. Ordinal/participating counters and existing empty-stream guards remain. No new mask arrays, alias/SCEV versioning, unbounded/dynamic scratch or additional original-input reads are introduced. Physical stack traffic, pressure, target execution and speedup are unmeasured.
limitations: The worker ran no builds, compilers, test runners, lit RUNs, VectorizeTests, execution checker or try.sh. This revision is unvalidated until the harness completes all requested work. The certificate only covers the demonstrated compact reduction fixture shapes, one tail forwarding hop, optional single middle.block forwarding and the existing bounded output forms; arbitrary types/opcodes/CFGs, copy chains, conditional forwarding and longer chains remain rejected. It does not prove arbitrary memory equivalence or substitute for IR verification and executable comparison. New retained fixtures are parser/checker inputs, not RVV or host executable evidence. Other affine LV2 exits were inspected structurally only; their existing count/preservation certificates were not broadened. Compiler limitations such as unbounded/oversized untiled storage, producer cycles/extra recurrences, unsupported calls/effects/live-outs, independent participation streams, non-affine controls and strictfp/constrained FP remain. Fixed-vscale host execution is not EVL/VP or RVV target execution; verified code generation is not a speedup measurement. No selection gain, performance improvement or direction maturity is claimed. Immutable benchmarks, production fission legality, other worktrees, Git index/history/refs, binaries and unfinished d2 work are untouched.
test_expectations: New reduction-fission-compact-tail-checker.test retains the exact full affine_compact LV1 and LV2 scalar-remainder functions from t000032. Direct and one-hop outputs, renamed forwarding/output labels, renamed LCSSA values, untrusted predecessor comments and probe insertion must pass the production affine checker.

Focused mutations require the compact scalar-result diagnostic and the intended obligation. They cover wrong tail/join/output values and types, wrong starts/backedges, reversed tail/middle/bypass edges, extra branch/switch predecessors, conditional forwarding, self cycles, longer chains, additional PHIs/arithmetic/calls/stores, copy/same-prefix values, broken vector LCSSA values/types/edges/cardinality, final output linkage and ordered-FP flags. Existing count-branch tests explicitly require their existing count-provenance diagnostic instead.

The older synthetic scalar-tail fixture formerly used constants as tail results, omitted scalar/vector accumulators and discarded outputs. It now supplies real typed recurrences, distinct integer vector results, scalar resume values, an explicit zero-entry branch and final output PHIs/stores so its existing positive/probe/count mutations must satisfy the stronger certificate. No correctness rejection is removed; signature-specialization helpers/tests and exact-label construction tests are untouched.

The C harness retains all existing original/transformed/independent comparisons, aliases/canaries/signed-zero/inactive-operand checks and enclosing-row tests. It now requires entered-producer P=0, scalar-only, vector-exact and mixed paths for each compact compiled LV1/LV2, FP-option and vscale variant. It separately requires P=VF-1, VF and VF+1 where these fit the existing P=0..65 sweep. For VF>65 only zero-participant and scalar-only execution are feasible and required.
